p: sent her back: It may seem that he sent her back for a time to her father for her impatience, lest she should be a hinderance to his calling, which was so dangerous, Ex 4:25.

mount of God: Horeb is called the mount of God, because God did many miracles there. So Peter calls the mount where Christ was transfigured, the holy mount: for by Christ's presence it was holy for a time, 2Pe 1:18.
said unto Moses: That is, he sent messengers to say to him.
Blessed be the LORD: By this it is evident that he worshipped the true God, and therefore Moses did not refuse to marry his daughter.
he was above them: For they that drowned the children of the Israelites, perished themselves by water.
before God: They ate in the place, where the sacrifice was offered: for part was burnt, and the rest eaten.
God: That is, to know God's will, and to have justice executed.
God-ward: You judge in difficult cases, which cannot be decided without consulting with God.
able men: What manner of men ought to be chosen to bear office.

hearkened to the voice of his: Godly counsel should always be obeyed, even if it comes from our inferiors, for to such God often gives wisdom to humble those that are exalted, and to declare that one member has need of another.
let his father in law depart: Read Nu 10:29.
